why_this_fixture: A whole IntentV1 document graded end to end — the entry point a consumer holding only the artifact uses. It pins three things a per-row case cannot: that components are graded before capabilities, that node_shape rows are NOT graded at all (ADR 1084 makes a federated goatnet's nodes deliberately unequal, so comparing them would manufacture skew), and that the fixture's own content_hash is reproducible byte-for-byte from its body — which is what makes the canonical serialization a cross-language contract rather than a Python detail.
